column1: # docs/counts.tsv — the dated snapshot of every total the generated docs publish (README.md, docs/EVALS.md,
# docs/LIMITS.md, docs/TUNING.md, the deck). Generated, do not edit: `python3 docs/counts_snapshot.py refresh`
# re-takes it from the tree; `check` compares it with the tree. A feature PR leaves it alone, which is what keeps
# two open PRs that each add a gate or a cap from conflicting on a total.
